We assume that the data were downloaded from the NIMH Data Archive (NDA) as a Data Package and saved to `{{< var nda.dir >}}` inside the project folder (@sec-nda describes what a package contains). Each NDA data structure is a table, `<structure>.txt`, and any files that the structure references are underneath a folder of the same name, `<structure>/`. Paths in the text start from the folder that holds the structure's files (for the MRI data, `<structure>/{{< var nda.prefix >}}`), while code chunks spell out the full path from the project folder.
